title: BugScanner
description: Bug bounty, red team ve pentest için modüler web reconnaissance ve vulnerability assessment frameworkü; subdomain/port/technology/endpoint keşfi, XSS, SQLi, CORS, SSRF, JWT, IDOR, sensitive data ve business-logic kontrolleri, Nuclei entegrasyonu, false-positive doğrulama, WAF-aware rate limiting ve HTML/JSON raporlama sunar.
